objective: Membuktikan bahwa 10 EOS skills bukan sekadar terstandarisasi dan dapat dikomposisikan, tetapi juga reliable, compliant, reproducible, dan aman digunakan dalam Digital Operations Pilot.
scope: 10 existing skills. Tidak menambah skill baru.

workstreams.name: Contract Compliance
workstreams.focus: Trigger, exclusion, input/output, precondition, risk, authority

workstreams.name: Functional Evaluation
workstreams.focus: Invocation, correctness, golden cases, edge cases

workstreams.name: Regression Assurance
workstreams.focus: Perubahan skill dan dampaknya terhadap workflow

workstreams.name: Reliability & SLA
workstreams.focus: Latency, timeout, failure rate, recovery, availability

workstreams.name: Security & Governance
workstreams.focus: Least privilege, secret handling, mutation boundary, approval

acceptance_gates.name: Inventory Integrity
acceptance_gates.criteria: Seluruh 10 skill ditemukan dan identitasnya konsisten

acceptance_gates.name: Contract Compliance
acceptance_gates.criteria: Seluruh skill memenuhi kontrak dan metadata wajib

acceptance_gates.name: Invocation Reliability
acceptance_gates.criteria: Skill dapat ditemukan dan dipanggil oleh host yang ditargetkan

acceptance_gates.name: Functional Correctness
acceptance_gates.criteria: Golden cases menghasilkan output sesuai acceptance criteria

acceptance_gates.name: Governance Compliance
acceptance_gates.criteria: Tidak ada pelanggaran authority, ownership, atau mutation policy

acceptance_gates.name: Regression Safety
acceptance_gates.criteria: Perubahan tidak merusak skill maupun workflow yang bergantung padanya

acceptance_gates.name: Failure & Recovery
acceptance_gates.criteria: Timeout, invalid input, dependency failure, dan recovery teruji

acceptance_gates.name: Security Assurance
acceptance_gates.criteria: Tidak ada temuan kritis terkait secrets, permission, atau eksekusi

acceptance_gates.name: Pilot Readiness
acceptance_gates.criteria: Workflow Digital Operations dapat dijalankan dengan evidence end-to-end
